**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on Meridian Fieldworks:

- **§ 12.3** expressly disclaims it: *"Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."*
- **§ 7.1** ties Fees to the Order Form with no best-terms or price-matching undertaking.
- **§ 8.3** caps renewal increases (lesser of CPI and 3%) — Vendor-side restraint, not a Customer MFN.
- Full-text searches for "most favoured", "favourable/favorable", "no less", "best", and "match" returned no Customer-side best-terms language anywhere in the document.

Nothing to delete, and no Vendor-granted MFN to preserve. Note for the wider review (outside this rule's scope): §§ 2.1–2.2 (take-or-pay and sole-provider exclusivity) and § 12.4 (24-month Customer non-compete) are materially adverse to us and directly contradict § 12.3 — those should be picked up by the exclusivity/commitment rules.
